newsitem.title: USA: Datakey posts Q1 loss as revenues decline.
newsitem.headline: Datakey posts Q1 loss as revenues decline.

text.p: Datakey Inc said Wednesday an expected revenue decline contributed to a loss in the first quarter ended March 29 versus a profit last year.
The company said it lost $1.4 million, or $0.37 a share, compared to net income of $17,000, or $0.01, in the same period in 1996.
Revenues fell to $1.4 million from $1.7 million primarily from a decline in orders from Datakey's major original equipment manufacturing customers, the company said.
Datakey said it expects revenue to improve slightly in the second quarter and it anticipates revenue from its new advanced information security products to begin in the third quarter.
The company announced in February it expects to report a loss for 1997 because of research and development spending.
Datakey makes electronic products and services.
